jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp439_queen_spaw: SCP-439: a pale, swollen queen that crawls slowly but never stops searching. She looks for a living person or villager to settle in.
Whoever she reaches grows slow and heavy over the following days. What is left behind does not stay empty for long.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp439_worker_spa: SCP-439-2: small pale workers that leave the nest to forage, then carry what they find back home.
They leave people alone unless provoked, and they never fight alone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp439_brute_spaw: SCP-439-2 brutes: heavy soldiers with long armoured heads and sickle jaws. They keep close to the nest.
They do not tolerate visitors, and they do not follow far.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp439.0: Something is coming. It moves slowly.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp439.1: Keep people indoors and keep count of them.
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp439.2: Do not leave the remains where they fall.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.title: The Nesting Queen
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.caption: An SCP-439-1 instance in a storage shed, two SCP-439-2 workers beside it. The seated posture is typical.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.0.text.0: SCP-439 is to be kept in a sealed terrarium with smooth walls, fed through an outer hatch. No person is to enter the enclosure. **Count every member of staff on the way in and on the way out.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.0.text.1: Any person who has been within reach of SCP-439 is to be watched for slowness or stiffness and kept apart from others until cleared.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.0.text.2: SCP-439-1 instances are not to be approached on foot. Remains of anyone lost to SCP-439 are never to be left where they fall.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.1.text.0: SCP-439 is a pale, termite-like organism about two metres long. It has a small grey head and thorax, short beaded antennae and a greatly swollen abdomen banded with dark grey plates. It moves slowly and with obvious effort, but it does not stop.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.1.text.1: SCP-439 seeks out people and villagers. Once it reaches one, it nips them and is not seen again. The person it reached, termed a carrier, grows slow and heavy over the following days and complains of a dry rustling that no one else can place.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.1.text.2: No carrier has survived. The remains, designated SCP-439-1, slump into a hunched, seated posture and are covered by jagged, overlapping plates of grey growth like old bone. Clothing, hair and skin stay visible for a time, until the body is completely enclosed. The finished mass keeps one dark socket and a wide, dark mouth that slowly strains open.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.1.text.3: A fully enclosed SCP-439-1 releases SCP-439-2: small pale workers that forage, hunt animals and carry what they find back to the remains, and heavier soldiers with long armoured heads that stay close and will not tolerate visitors.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.1.text.4: A well-fed SCP-439-1 has, on %rone occasion%r, released something larger that left the area and was not followed.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.2.title: Addendum 439-1: Arrival
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.2.text: SCP-439 has no recovery record. The first instance appeared some time after a researcher read this file, out in the open and some distance away, and began to search at once.
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.3.title: Addendum 439-2: Incident Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.3.text.0: Incident 439-04: an SCP-439-1 instance was destroyed with fire. Every SCP-439-2 instance in the area stopped moving within seconds. %rThe remainder of the report is sealed.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.439.page.3.text.1: Incident 439-06: a carrier was moved to a medical wing in the early stages. %rOutcome withheld pending review.%r
